description.en: A presenter that showcases chart-rendering samples from the Data Positioning D3 visualiser tool (Sankey diagram, and bar chart via TanStack Charts) and phoria2 visualiser tool (3D network topology).

description.en: A grouped bar chart rendered with TanStack Charts.
A Unovis chord diagram rendering directional relationships between teams.
A D3 Sankey diagram rendering source-to-target flow volumes.
A phoria2 3D map of a network, coloured by status, with live traffic along its links.
